true_memory.speaker: MEMORY
true_memory.text: Mira begged you to abort. You overrode the safety lockout to finish the scan.

true_memory.speaker: VOICE
true_memory.text: The field collapsed before the emergency shutdown could complete.

false_memory.speaker: MEMORY
false_memory.text: The lockout failed on its own. There was nothing you could have done.

false_memory.speaker: VOICE
false_memory.text: No. You remember making the choice. Order the fragments again.
